item.title: Bereaved family of Kurdish man who died in custody sues Tokyo government
item.description: The man's death "reflects a profound lack of human rights awareness within the police organization," the family's attorney said.

item.title: Children in Japan like reading, but most read less than an hour a week: survey
item.description: The survey's findings suggest that even children who enjoy books may be spending less time reading because they prefer videos and games.

item.title: The Japan Times wins two awards at WAN-IFRA Asian Media Awards 2026
item.description: The Japan Times, Ltd. (Chairperson, Publisher and President: Minako Suematsu) has received two awards from the World Association of News and News Publishers (WAN-IFRA) at the WAN-IFRA Asian Media Awards 2026.

item.title: Hillary Clinton visits Hiroshima Peace Memorial Museum
item.description: Clinton said that as many people as possible should visit the museum, according to a former governor of Hiroshima Prefecture who guided.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
